reviews.text: One of the best decisions I made after purchasing my new home in the sky was to contact Michael at M4 Specialty Company.  Michael helped transform my new place by adding much needed protection from the sun and heat combined with a stylish modern touch that keeps the views visible from my soaring windows.  Miguel did an amazing job with the installation and made the entire process stress free.  I definitely recommend this company and will use them again.

As an architect, I am very selected on the people and companies that I select to do work for me, either on my house or at our office. We recently had shades installed at our newly renovated office by Micheal, Mark and the team at M4. We couldn't have been more pleased with the work they did. They went above and beyond to make sure each shade fit the window as best as possible. I would highly recommend M$ for your next window treatment project!

Love our new drop down screens!  The temperature difference on our westward facing patio is significant and brings much relief plus no more bugs!  From start to finish, service was great!  Michael was very responsive and really listened to what we wanted.  M4 certainly delivered. Timely crew arrival and great cleanup when all was said and done. Michael made sure that we were 100% satisfied with our install and product before he left. Definitely would recommend them.

I recommend anyone that is looking for custom shades to give M4 a call and speak to Michael. Working with Michael and his team was excellent. Thanks to their knowledge, our shutters are PERFECT. They look AMAZING, and ABSOLUTELY transformed the look of our home. He will guide you in the absolute right direction.  Their attention to detail is fabulous, and the staff is superb. M4 went above and beyond to make sure that our shutters were exactly what I had envisioned.  I have nothing but praise I

Michael with M4 helped us decide on the perfect solution for our space. We thought we knew what we wanted, but after discussing our needs with him at the in-person consult, he was able to help us think outside of the box. His knowledge and creativity is what sets him apart from his competitors. We didn’t even know what the possibilities were for our patio until he brought his ideas.  The installation went very smooth, they crew was extremely professional and we love the end result!  Thank you!

M4 did such a spectacular job on our shutters. They were helpful in the selection process, with so many ideas and suggestions.  The quality of the shutters is amazing, and their level of service was impeccable.  Installers were wearing gloves and masks, and took the utmost care in installation.  Would absolutely use them again!

Our office had a great experience with M4 Specialty!
Their installation crew was very professional, efficient, top quality. They also took the time to demonstrate how everything worked and made sure I was up to par on my proficiency with their product. Great customer experience for us!

What a great experience we had with Michael Murphy and his team at M4 Specialty Company. Our Company had found M4 on Google and reached out to them on a rather large, 200 window, 3 story office space. Mr. Murphy was very knowledgeable and professional in his guidance on shades for our building. Everything M4 promised they delivered on the highest of quality. From ordering, all the way through to the install process of the shades went so smooth i would recommend this company with the highest of h

We love our new remote outdoor shades!    They are perfect!    They give us an outdoor room all year round!     We are thrilled with our purchase and M4Specialty!

M4 Specialty has excellent and responsive customer service.    We put in a call
and they had made the needed adjustments needed very quickly.

We just moved into our dream home after long months of planning and everything else that goes into building a home from the ground up. There were so many details to consider. One thing we did not think of until the last minute were window treatments. Like buttons on a shirt, window coverings are a very important, final detail that you can't do without; but, you take for granted when they are perfectly in place and doing their job. He then determined the perfect placement in our backyard, making several trips to “tweak” the location, there were several contractors on the job, as other aspects of the project were completed

M4 provided and installed plantation shutters throughout our entire home and they look fantastic! Michael is a great guy to work with and provides high quality workmanship at great rates. Any blinds and shutter work we need going forward will be done with M4!

M4 Specialties is highly professional, prompt, and very knowledgeable.  I would recommend this company for any and all needs you may have.  The products ordered were perfect, the installation process was smooth, and the tech cleaned up any mess, although there was nearly no mess at all!  Definitely consider this company, we will definitely reach out should we have any further orders!  Thank you for everything!

Great experience from beginning to end with M4.
Our shades are beautiful and work amazing. We were so impressed with the install crew and their promptness and cleanliness. I would highly recommend M4 Specialty Co. to any and all of my friends

I couldn't be happier with this company!! From the initial contact to the eventual install - complete  professionalism.. I had a bit of a unique situation. The porch extension sadly was not executed properly, ( by a completely different contractor) but Michael and his top notch installers lead by Luis, managed to work around many imperfections!.. I receive positive reviews from anyone that visits. Do yourself a favor and contact M4 for your screen needs!!!

This is the second time we have used M4 Specialty Company and once again they knocked it out of the park.   We had a previous contractor install a curtain rod and curtains and they failed.  We called Michael and his team they were there to fix the problem.  They were quick, responsive and did phenomenal work without any issues.  Thanks for everything M4 Specialty Company.

I would like to sincerely recommend Michael and his company, M4 Specialty Company.  Michael went over and above to solve my problem which really was not his problem nor did he profit from the work he put into the solution.  Some times I wonder if there are many people and/or companies left that are willing to go the extra mile, but Michael and his company are definitely rated as such in my book.  If you need anything they can help you with please do not hesitate to use them with greatest confide

Highly recommend! Very professional, great communication, and they look GREAT! We were worried these were going to cost a fortune and found them to be well within our budget. Michael was on time, gave us great ideas on what to expect and his recommendation on style. We love them so much we’re looking into using them on our whole house!

We had our blinds installed today. M4 has always been on time and communicates well. We had a problem with a wrong fabric on one blind and the problem was acknowledged and a corrective action was agreed to within the hour. Our installer was personable and knowledgeable.

These guys are amazing. Great quality. Super responsive customer service and professional. They had folks out here taking measurements right after the first phone call and the entire turnaround from inquiry to installation was very fast. They powder coated our screen tracks to match the outdoor finishes we had previously installed and it looks great. We use the screen all the time and it makes a huge difference. Can’t imagine life without it now.
